mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( business_id, coupon_id, subscription_plan, billing_period_start, billing_period_end, amount, discount_amount, final_amount, coupon_code, payment_method, payment_status, pg_provider, pg_transaction_id, webhook_received_at, webhook_data ) VALUES ( #{businessId}, #{couponId}, #{subscriptionPlan}, #{billingPeriodStart}, #{billingPeriodEnd}, #{amount}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalAmount}, #{couponCode}, #{paymentMethod}::payment_method, #{paymentStatus}::payment_status, #{pgProvider}, #{pgTransactionId}, #{webhookReceivedAt}, #{webhookData, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb )
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET payment_status = #{paymentStatus}::payment_status, pg_provider = #{pgProvider}, pg_transaction_id = #{pgTransactionId}, webhook_received_at = #{webhookReceivedAt}, webhook_data = #{webhookData, typeHandler=io.moer.booking.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}::jsonb, paid_at = #{paidAt}, failed_reason = #{failedReason}, refunded_at = #{refundedAt}, refund_amount = #{refundAmount}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE business_id = #{businessId} AND payment_status = 'COMPLETED'::payment_status ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
